- Reported host aternos.com serves an empty placeholder frameset; the real site (aternos.org) is off-origin and cannot be loaded: The issue's trusted URL is http:⁠//aternos.com/. In the locked adguard_cli session the reported origin returns a 220-byte frameset placeholder with an empty frame for /, and every path (/en/, /servers/) 302s to /index.html, which is the same placeholder:⁠ no visible text, no ad slots (inspect_ad_slots candidateCount 0), no third-party requests beyond local.adguard.org. Nothing in the run instruction or guidance says how to validate a report whose reported host no longer serves the site whose symptom the reporter documented. Live evidence for the reported ads and anti-adblock wall therefore cannot be collected in any session this environment allows.
